name: com.pyai/mcp
title: PyAI Voice AI
description: Speech, transcription, voice agents, Trace, Recap, dubbing and narration with browser OAuth.

tools.name: openapi_get
tools.description: Fetch live API operation discovery with a SHA-256 digest. Supply path and method for one operation and its referenced schemas, or include_document=true for the entire contract. Pin sha256 to detect contract drift. No API key required.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Return a concise, correct quickstart for building with PyAI (auth, SDK install, TTS/STT/realtime snippets, error handling). No key or network needed, read this before writing PyAI code so you use the right endpoints and the official SDK.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Introspect the active key (GET /v1/me): org, environment (test/live), granted scopes, and rate-limit/credit posture. Organization and project names and IDs, billing guidance, and any managed payer/budget appear in text and structuredContent. Names are display labels; verify IDs and environment too. Use verbose=true for key identity details. Use it before usage and to diagnose a 401/403/402.

verbose.description: Include authorized identity details in text. Credentials are always omitted.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the available PyAI models (catalog). No arguments.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: Browse stock and saved designed voices. Filter stock voices by spoken language, accent/locale, gender or product. Prefer a locale for a regional accent. If no matching voice is listed, explain the gap before offering alternatives.

gender.description: Filter by voice gender (e.g. female, male).

language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. en, es or fr. Combine with region for an accent.

product.description: Use speak for prerecorded speech and omni for a live voice agent.

region.description: Requested accent or locale, e.g. en-US, en-GB, en-AU, es-MX or fr-CA. Use the requested locale even if availability is unknown.

tools.name: synthesize_speech
tools.description: Generate speech from input. Consumes usage in the connected project; live usage can be billed. Before generation, use whoami to verify project, environment, scopes, credit and limits. Returns inline MCP audio or an expiring resource_link, never a local file path. Host playback support varies. For integration code only, use get_started.

input.description: Text to synthesize. Maximum 2000 characters; longer text answers `400 input_too_long` naming the limit and the length you sent. Split longer scripts into several requests.

voice.description: Voice id from list_voices. Omit for the account default.

tools.name: create_transcription_job
tools.description: Submit an async speech-to-text job for an audio URL (https). Returns a job_id; poll with get_transcription_job. Supports diarization.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio to transcribe.

transcription_language.description: Spoken-language hint applied to every channel, chunk and speech span. Omit for automatic detection. Independent of the Recap summary language.

call_id.description: Stable id for the post-call Recap. Defaults to the job id.

tools.name: get_transcription_job
tools.description: Get the status + result of a transcription job by id.

tools.name: configure_amd
tools.description: Set the PyAI AMD (answering-machine detection) operating point + webhook (POST /v1/amd/config). `aggressiveness` is one dial 0-1: near 0 is human-safe (never hang up on a person), near 1 fires 'machine' fast. The realtime detection itself is a Twilio Media Streams WebSocket (wss /v1/amd/stream), a one-line-TwiML drop-in, not an MCP tool.

webhook_url.description: https URL to POST amd.call.completed events to.

tools.name: list_amd_calls
tools.description: List recent PyAI AMD decisions (GET /v1/amd/calls). Each carries answered_by (human/voicemail/ivr/screening/sit_invalid/…), answered_by_twilio (Twilio's enum, for routing parity), confidence, decision_ms, and the word-level reason.

session_label.description: Filter by the opaque connect-URL/TwiML tag.

tools.name: get_amd_call
tools.description: Get one PyAI AMD decision by call id (GET /v1/amd/calls/{id}): who/what answered, with the reason.

call_id.description: The call id the decision was recorded under.

tools.name: enable_recap
tools.description: Enable Recap for the key's org (PUT /v1/recap/config). Sandbox keys already mint with Recap on; call this to set a webhook or pack, or to enable Recap on a signup/live key. Requires recap:configure.

tools.name: create_recap
tools.description: Submit speaker-labelled utterances and get a recap.call (POST /v1/recap/calls/{call_id}). Requires recap:create and Recap enabled. To poll with get_recap, also request recap:lookup.

call_id.description: Stable id you will read back.

tools.name: get_recap
tools.description: Read one Recap by call id (GET /v1/recap/calls/{call_id}). When complete, `record` is recap.record.v1 (tldr, summary, action_items, disposition, next_steps, talk_ratio, signals, fields). Requires recap:lookup and Recap enabled.

call_id.description: The call_id passed to create_recap or the Hear job.

tools.name: list_recap_calls
tools.description: List existing Recap records for the organization (GET /v1/recap/calls). Requires recap:lookup and Recap enabled.

tools.name: omni_list_calls
tools.description: List Omni sessions, including inbound calls. Filter by session_label and preserve each returned call_id.

session_label.description: Only calls connected with this opaque session tag.

tools.name: omni_get_call
tools.description: Read an Omni session's transcript, recording availability and summary. For outbound calls use artifacts.omni_call_id from calls_get.

call_id.description: Stable opaque PyAI-owned call identifier. Use it unchanged across every Omni call sub-resource.

tools.name: omni_get_summary
tools.description: Read the structured summary for an Omni call when generated; a missing summary is not an empty result.

call_id.description: Stable opaque PyAI-owned call identifier. Use it unchanged across every Omni call sub-resource.

tools.name: omni_get_transcript
tools.description: Read the complete Omni call transcript through the authenticated API.

call_id.description: Stable opaque PyAI-owned call identifier. Use it unchanged across every Omni call sub-resource.

tools.name: omni_get_recording
tools.description: Get the canonical authenticated recording resource URL. Requires response=url. This URL is not public playable audio; recording must have been enabled.

call_id.description: Stable opaque PyAI-owned call identifier. Use it unchanged across every Omni call sub-resource.

response.description: Set to `url` to return the canonical authenticated PyAI recording resource as JSON.

tools.name: telephony_search_numbers
tools.description: Search available managed numbers and inspect provisioning requirements before purchase.

contains.description: Digit pattern the number should contain.

tools.name: telephony_list_numbers
tools.description: List owned numbers and current Agent bindings before changing inbound routing.

tools.name: telephony_bind_number
tools.description: Bind an owned number to an Agent using body.agent_id; null unassigns. Read existing bindings first. Changes inbound routing.

agent_id.description: Agent to bind, or null to unassign.

tools.name: telephony_create_call
tools.description: Place a real outbound call only to a user-authorized destination. Requires confirm=true and a stable idempotency_key. This is not a sandbox simulation. Preserve the returned ID; never redial after an uncertain timeout.

max_duration_seconds.description: Carrier-enforced maximum duration for integration calls.

client_reference.description: Stable client call identity; requires agent_release_id.

agent_release_id.description: Client release identifier pinned to this call; requires client_reference.

stop_requested.description: Recover or cancel the same intent without dialing an unstarted call. Requires client_reference. Excluded from the creation fingerprint.

from_number_id.description: Active managed-number ID to present as caller ID.

to.description: Supported E.164 destination: North America (+1), India (+91), or Australian geographic/mobile numbers (+61, without the domestic trunk zero). Country policy, destination consent and caller identity remain required. Australian number purchasing is not available; an existing owned source number can be connected separately.

agent_id.description: Omni agent that handles the connected call.

use_case.description: Declared calling purpose. Determines consent, identity, CNAM, and policy gates.

idempotency_key.description: Required safe-retry key. Identical retries return the original call; a different body returns 409.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user authorizes this exact purchase or destination.

tools.name: calls_list
tools.description: List outbound calls and normalized network outcomes before retrying a dispatch.

cursor.description: Last call id from the previous page. Tenant and project scoped.

tools.name: calls_get
tools.description: Read the current state of an outbound call by returned ID. dispatch_unknown needs inspection, not another call. Recap and Omni recordings are separate resources.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List saved voice Agent profiles before creating or changing one.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create a reusable voice Agent profile: persona, greeting, voice, language, tools and knowledge. Does not place a call. Use saved tool IDs; configure connection settings privately in the PyAI console. Never supply credentials.

body.description: Writable agent fields. On update, present fields are set, `null` clears, absent fields are untouched.

persona_system_prompt.description: Customer-authored agent instructions: 8,000 Unicode characters by default, or 32,000 with an active monthly commitment plan. Read prompt_limit_characters on the agent for your allowance. Platform conversation and safety guidance is applied separately and does not count toward this allowance. This is a character limit, not a token count.

role.description: Role archetype. Adds PyAI's role operating standard beneath your persona and derives the runtime mode (`receptionist`, `sales`, and `collections` enable their matching deterministic conversation guards; everything else runs the default mode). Your stored persona is unchanged and remains authoritative for identity and business policy. Null clears the role.

greeting.description: Greeting message, opening line spoken at turn 0 when a call connects (before the caller speaks). Stored on the agent profile; played automatically when connecting with `session_label={agent_id}`. May also be sent inline in the Omni `configure` frame.

greeting_variants.description: Approved opening-line variants. PyAI selects one for each newly resolved call profile; null or empty falls back to greeting. Recording consent is fixed and never rotated.

voice_id.description: A stock `voice_id`, one of its permanent `aliases` from `GET /v1/voices`, or a cloned voice id. Omni reports the canonical served stock id in `configured.voice_id`.

voice_instruct.description: Stored delivery direction for instruct-capable voice tiers. Current Omni routes support neutral delivery only: omit or set null for neutral speech. A saved custom value is rejected when configuring Omni; an inline empty `configure.voice_instruct` resets it to neutral for that session.

brain_model.description: Per-agent model selection. Omit for the platform default.

barge_sensitivity.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Stored values are not applied to Omni runtime.

ack_mode.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Stored values are not applied to Omni runtime.

idle_check_in.description: How patient the agent is before checking in on a silent caller ("Sorry, are you still there?"). `auto` checks in after a few seconds of silence; `patient` waits far longer, for callers who routinely think, read, or look something up mid-call; `off` disables the check-in entirely, so the agent stays silent until the caller speaks. When unset, most roles render `auto`; support agents render `patient`. Independent of `ack_mode`. May also be sent inline in the Omni `configure` frame, which wins for that session.

persona_perspective.description: Which side of the call the persona is on. `agent` (default) means the persona is the business being called, so PyAI adds its conversation layer for handling a caller (capability honesty, handoffs, turn discipline). `caller` means the persona is the individual on the call instead, as in QA and simulation callers, mystery shopping, or training partners; PyAI drops that operator-voice layer so it cannot contradict an inverted persona. May also be sent inline in the Omni `configure` frame, which wins for that session.

platform_guidance.description: Integration-owned setup guidance. Requires an explicitly enrolled server credential; ordinary customer keys receive 403. Separate from persona_system_prompt and its account allowance. Published before the customer instructions without truncation.

inherit_org_knowledgebases.description: When no knowledge bases are explicitly bound, inherit the organization's default knowledge bases. Set false to restrict retrieval to explicit agent bindings; an empty binding list then means no retrieval.

recordings_enabled.description: Enable stereo call recordings. Default false.

consent_line.description: Recording disclosure spoken before recording starts when `recordings_enabled` is true. Required for compliance when recordings are on and must contain a meaningful spoken phrase (at least 10 characters and 5 letters). Playback order: consent_line, then greeting, then conversation.

language.description: Requested language for this Agent's Omni sessions. `null` or absent means `en`. Availability is staged: public serving includes `en`, `fr`, `es`, `hi`, `it`, `pt`, `ja`, and `ko`; `de` and the legacy `zh` alias fall back to English unless explicitly enabled with qualified endpoints. Canonical staged route identifiers are exposed in `x-staged-language-ids` for internal integration only and are rejected by the public control plane until qualified. Inspect the session's `configured.language_active` and `language_fallback` fields before assuming the requested language is active. See the Language support reference.

metadata.description: Up to 16 key/value annotations (keys ≤64 chars, values ≤512 chars).

vocabulary.description: Optional custom vocabulary for this Agent's Omni speech recognition. A non-empty list is the opt-in. PyAI keeps at most five effective terms, with at most five words per term. It trims whitespace, deduplicates without regard to case while preserving the first spelling and order, and drops common-only phrases. Set `[]` or `null` to turn it off. The list is fixed when a session starts. Organization Hear vocabulary is never applied to Omni.

keyterms.description: Deprecated stored compatibility field. It does not affect speech recognition. Use `vocabulary`.

goals.description: Goal checklist for post-call outcome scoring (stored now; scoring ships with summaries).

extraction_schema.description: JSON Schema of fields to capture from each completed call's transcript. When set with extraction_webhook_url, PyAI runs a post-call extraction pass and POSTs the structured JSON to your webhook (signed with X-PyAI-Signature). Null disables extraction.

extraction_webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the signed post-call extraction result (event `omni.call.extracted`). Requires extraction_schema. The call's agent is resolved from the connect-URL session_label when it equals this agent's id.

tool_id.description: ID of an existing tool. Configure its connection privately in the PyAI console.

tools.description: Replace bindings using saved tool IDs. Existing settings are preserved for retained bindings. Credentials and connection settings are not accepted through MCP.

continuity.description: Reuse a tiny caller card on the next call when PyAI can resolve the caller (phone number or a signed customer id). The card is advisory — the agent may recall a name or open thread, and must not refund, book, or transfer from it. Default false.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Read a saved voice Agent profile and its current configuration.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Update a voice Agent profile. Read it first and change only user-requested fields. Use saved tool IDs; configure connection settings privately in the PyAI console. Never supply credentials.

body.description: Writable agent fields. On update, present fields are set, `null` clears, absent fields are untouched.

tools.name: set_agent_tools
tools.description: Replace the tools bound to an Agent. Read the current Agent first; this replaces its bindings. Use saved tool IDs; configure connection settings privately in the PyAI console. Never supply credentials.

tool_id.description: ID of an existing tool. Configure its connection privately in the PyAI console.

body.description: Replace bindings using saved tool IDs. Existing settings are preserved for retained bindings. Credentials and connection settings are not accepted through MCP.

tools.name: set_agent_knowledge
tools.description: Replace the knowledge bases bound to an Agent. Read its existing bindings first.

weight.description: Retrieval weight relative to other bound bases.

tools.name: list_published_website_widgets
tools.description: Look up published managed website voice widgets in the connected project without an agent ID. Read their public embed snippets, exact origins and effective daily session limits. Follow next_cursor while has_more before concluding no match. Ask which widget if multiple match. This read does not create a widget or start a session.

cursor.description: Pass next_cursor from the previous page.

tools.name: draft_website_widget
tools.description: Save an unpublished website voice widget for a saved agent in the connected project. Specify the exact HTTPS origin and both daily session limits. The hosted widget sends visitor microphone audio to PyAI. Its session quotas cannot enforce a hard total spending cap. To replace a draft, first preview it and pass its expected_revision. A published widget cannot be edited here.

id.description: Saved agent ID in the authenticated project.

origin.description: Exact HTTPS origin, including any non-default port. No wildcard, path, query, fragment or credentials.

daily_session_limit.description: Maximum visitor sessions per UTC day for the widget. This is a session count, not a spending limit.

ip_daily_session_limit.description: Maximum visitor sessions per IP per UTC day.

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision from the latest preview. Required to replace a changed draft.

tools.name: preview_website_widget
tools.description: Read the saved managed website voice widget for this agent. Show its project, exact origins, session limits, status, embed snippet, readiness and revision before asking to publish. Does not publish or start a session.

id.description: Saved agent ID in the authenticated project.

tools.name: publish_website_widget
tools.description: Publish the managed website voice widget only after the user explicitly approves the displayed project, origins, limits and embed for that exact preview revision. Set body.approved=true and pass body.revision. Return the snippet verbatim. The hosted widget sends visitor microphone audio to PyAI. Sessions may consume project credit and session quotas cannot enforce a hard total spending cap. After an uncertain result, preview the widget before any further action.

id.description: Saved agent ID in the authenticated project.

approved.description: Set only after the user explicitly approves the displayed preview.

revision.description: Opaque revision from that approved preview.

tools.name: get_trace_config
tools.description: Inspect Trace call-compliance configuration.

agent_id.description: Agent to read config for; omit for the org default.

tools.name: configure_trace
tools.description: Configure Trace compliance monitoring for the selected workspace.

body.description: Per-agent Trace config (spec §5.1). May be wrapped as { agent_id, config } or sent raw.

agent_id.description: Agent to configure; omit for the org-wide default.

rule_packs.description: Map of pack_id → { enabled, version }, e.g. { tcpa: { enabled: true } }.

guardrails.description: Inline guardrails compiled into a synthesized rule pack (spec §5.1).

mode.description: warn = log only (never blocks); modify = redact/inject; block = suppress; human_handoff = escalate.

patterns.description: Deterministically-redactable PII (context-dependent PII like DOB is Tier-2, not inline).

text.description: Phrase the agent must speak, e.g. an AI / recording disclosure.

trigger.description: call_start = must appear on the first agent turn.

required_within_seconds.description: Deadline in seconds; otherwise a 2-turn default applies.

blocked_phrases.description: Phrases the agent must never say.

fail_open.description: Trace down must never make a call worse, log 'unavailable' instead of blocking.

inline_timeout_ms.description: Inline budget; the in-process gate is ~14µs p99, far under this.

tools.name: list_trace_rule_packs
tools.description: Discover available Trace compliance rule packs before enabling monitoring.

tools.name: create_trace_rule_pack
tools.description: Create a workspace Trace compliance rule pack. This creates persistent configuration.

body.description: An authored rule pack in the Trace DSL (rule_pack_schema.json).

tools.name: list_trace_interactions
tools.description: Find monitored calls and interactions for compliance review.

tools.name: get_trace_interaction
tools.description: Read one monitored interaction and its compliance evidence.

tools.name: list_trace_findings
tools.description: Find compliance findings with source evidence. Findings are signals for review, not legal conclusions.

tools.name: list_trace_violations
tools.description: List Trace rule violations for compliance review.

tools.name: get_trace_exposure
tools.description: Read aggregate compliance exposure for the workspace.

tools.name: get_recap_config
tools.description: Read Recap summarization configuration before changing it.

tools.name: get_cast_capabilities
tools.description: Discover Cast voices, emotions, formats and supported rendering capabilities.

tools.name: direct_cast_script
tools.description: Turn a narration script into directed Cast lines before rendering. Consumes usage.

tools.name: render_cast
tools.description: Submit script text or directed lines using one top-level voice from get_cast_capabilities for the entire render. Per-line voices and a console project are not required or supported inputs. Returns a job; preserve its ID, poll get_cast_render and retrieve get_cast_audio when done. Consumes usage; do not resubmit on timeout.

tools.name: list_transcription_jobs
tools.description: Find existing audio processing and transcription jobs before submitting duplicates.

cursor.description: Opaque token from a previous page's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: discover_tools
tools.description: Find the right PyAI tools and a short recipe for speech, STT, LiveKit or Pipecat integration, voice agents, compliance, summaries, dubbing or narration. No credentials or usage.

query.description: Product, framework or task, e.g. “LiveKit”, “Pipecat integration”, “translate audio”, “voice agent”, “TTS”.

task.description: Alias for query. If both are supplied, they must match after trimming.

examples.query: Show the embed for my published website voice widget

tools.name: get_dub_capabilities
tools.description: Read currently supported Dub input and output languages before submitting a translation.

tools.name: create_dub
tools.description: Fetch audio from the user-authorized HTTPS source URL and start a translation and dubbing job. Accesses an external source and consumes usage. Keep job_id and poll get_dub_job; do not submit again after a timeout.

tools.name: get_dub_job
tools.description: Retrieve the status and available results of an existing dubbing job by job_id. This read does not start or repeat a job. Poll pending/processing states without resubmitting.

job_id.description: The ID returned by the original submission; do not invent one.

tools.name: get_dub_audio
tools.description: Retrieve completed dubbed audio as a playable result or download. Call only when get_dub_job reports done.

job_id.description: The ID returned by the original submission; do not invent one.

tools.name: get_cast_render
tools.description: Check a durable Cast render job. Preserve the original job ID.

job_id.description: The ID returned by the original submission; do not invent one.

tools.name: get_cast_audio
tools.description: Retrieve completed Cast narration as playable audio or a download.

job_id.description: The ID returned by the original submission; do not invent one.

tools.name: preview_cast_line
tools.description: Generate one directed Cast line. Consumes usage. Check get_cast_capabilities for supported voice, emotion and intensity.

intensity.description: Use a tier from Cast capabilities: subtle, balanced or bold; or a number from 0 to 1. Legacy low/med/high aliases are normalized by MCP.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe a small audio attachment supplied as base64 (up to 8 MiB decoded). Returns the synchronous transcript without diarization controls. For word timestamps and speaker labels, use create_transcription_job with diarize=true for mono or channel=true for stereo, then get_transcription_job. Consumes usage.

audio_base64.description: Base64-encoded audio bytes, without a data: prefix.
